item.title: 【Albums (lossy)】MP3 - Selena Gomez - 777 ("12 Unreleased Songs")
item.description:
Yesterday, unreleased songs from various Selena Gomez albums leaked, such as "Sucks To Be You (from Stars Dance)" and "Light (from Rare)," and many others, and fans made this album that I found available on Telegram.



12 Unreleased Songs

01 Paraiso
02 Choices
03 Try Your Luck
04 Satisfied
05 Good Energy (Interlude)
06 Better Than
07 Untraceable
08 BLISS
09 See U Never
10 Light
11 Sucks To Be You
12 DREAMGIRLS (with Camila Cabello)
